Accessors for network results

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/network-accessors.R
network-accessors.Rd

Extract the parts of a CelltypeNetworkResult (returned by run_celltype_network and run_exposure_network) and of a NetworkComparison (returned by run_comparative_network).

Usage

networkPrecision(x)

networkAdjacency(x)

networkStability(x)

networkNodes(x)

networkCelltype(x)

networkMethod(x)

diffEdges(x)

sharedEdges(x)

celltypeSpecificEdges(x)

comparisonSummary(x)

# S4 method for class 'CelltypeNetworkResult'
networkPrecision(x)

# S4 method for class 'CelltypeNetworkResult'
networkAdjacency(x)

# S4 method for class 'CelltypeNetworkResult'
networkStability(x)

# S4 method for class 'CelltypeNetworkResult'
networkNodes(x)

# S4 method for class 'CelltypeNetworkResult'
networkCelltype(x)

# S4 method for class 'CelltypeNetworkResult'
networkMethod(x)

# S4 method for class 'CelltypeNetworkResult'
metadata(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'NetworkComparison'
diffEdges(x)

# S4 method for class 'NetworkComparison'
sharedEdges(x)

# S4 method for class 'NetworkComparison'
celltypeSpecificEdges(x)

# S4 method for class 'NetworkComparison'
comparisonSummary(x)

Arguments

x

A CelltypeNetworkResult or, for diffEdges(), sharedEdges(), celltypeSpecificEdges() and comparisonSummary(), a NetworkComparison.

...

Ignored by metadata().

Value

networkPrecision()

Numeric feature-by-feature precision matrix.

networkAdjacency()

Feature-by-feature matrix of edge indicators (1 = edge, 0 = no edge).

networkStability()

Feature-by-feature matrix of edge selection frequencies, or a 0 by 0 matrix when none were stored.

networkNodes()

DataFrame with one row per feature, in the order of the matrix rows.

networkCelltype()

Character scalar: the cell type.

networkMethod()

Character scalar: the estimation method.

metadata()

List of parameters and summaries, for example n_donors, transform and edge_counts.

diffEdges()

DataFrame of edges that are unique to one cell type or present in some but not all networks.

sharedEdges()

DataFrame of edges present in every network.

celltypeSpecificEdges()

Named list of DataFrames, one per cell type with edges found only in that cell type.

comparisonSummary()

List with the compared cell types, edge counts and pairwise Jaccard overlap.

Examples

features <- c("G1", "G2", "M1")
make_network <- function(celltype, cross_weight) {
    precision <- diag(3)
    precision[1, 3] <- precision[3, 1] <- cross_weight
    adjacency <- (precision != 0) * 1L
    diag(adjacency) <- 0L
    dimnames(precision) <- dimnames(adjacency) <- list(features, features)
    CelltypeNetworkResult(
        precision = precision,
        adjacency = adjacency,
        node_info = S4Vectors::DataFrame(
            feature = features,
            omic_layer = c("transcript", "transcript", "metabolite")),
        celltype = celltype,
        metadata = list(n_donors = 20L))
}
mono <- make_network("Monocyte", -0.45)
networkCelltype(mono)
#> [1] "Monocyte"
networkAdjacency(mono)
#>    G1 G2 M1
#> G1  0  0  1
#> G2  0  0  0
#> M1  1  0  0
networkNodes(mono)
#> DataFrame with 3 rows and 2 columns
#>       feature  omic_layer
#>   <character> <character>
#> 1          G1  transcript
#> 2          G2  transcript
#> 3          M1  metabolite
metadata(mono)$n_donors
#> [1] 20

comparison <- run_comparative_network(mono, make_network("B cell", 0))
diffEdges(comparison)
#> DataFrame with 1 row and 7 columns
#>        node_i      node_j     layer_i     layer_j cross_omic        category
#>   <character> <character> <character> <character>  <logical>     <character>
#> 1          G1          M1  transcript  metabolite       TRUE unique_Monocyte
#>    max_diff
#>   <numeric>
#> 1      0.45
celltypeSpecificEdges(comparison)
#> $Monocyte
#> DataFrame with 1 row and 7 columns
#>        node_i      node_j     layer_i     layer_j cross_omic        category
#>   <character> <character> <character> <character>  <logical>     <character>
#> 1          G1          M1  transcript  metabolite       TRUE unique_Monocyte
#>    max_diff
#>   <numeric>
#> 1      0.45
#> 
comparisonSummary(comparison)$jaccard
#> $`Monocyte_vs_B cell`
#> [1] 0
#>
